sentences.text: Maatz rakennnus & kumppanit Oy is a newly registered company, entered in the register on 2026-10-09 under the industry code 39000, remediation activities and other waste management services.
A start-up notification and a board change were both registered on 2026-10-11.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file, and the register confidence for the entry is low.
For the fund this is a watchlist case, and the industry code is the only link to the thesis.
